spans.text: Yinsweir tueif chix ti chianrlif ti tsuf a tshenrweir key paufshinr yemanr, paufshinr nir tianfwux key chix ti leyx o.

entries.description: ti Shianftsangx tsaif yur key tsoxnur tueif chix ti chianrlif chixpen

entries.object: yur key tsoxnur tueif chix ti chianrlif chixpen

spans.text: Yinsweir Kuer Lianrhor ti kuercas ti chix an luskleyx Kuer Lianrhor ti Shianftsangx tsaif yur key tsoxnur tueif chix ti chianrlif chixpen, chix ti tsunxyanr thungs qotaux qoyov ti chianrlif phinrten ti shinfnianf, teyr key tshufcinf tsifyour su ti luskleyx ti cinfpuf sefhueif thungs sueiphinr senxhor ti kaisanf,

entries.task_id: thungs tsifyour|nir|ti sa phupianf tueif sifyanf nir ti sirshianf tshungxfenx nes tsungfyaufshinf lungv lungv
entries.description: thungs tsifyour nir ti sa phupianf tueif sifyanf nir ti sirshianf tshungxfenx nes tsungfyaufshinf lungv lungv
entries.subject: thungs tsifyour
entries.object: ti sa phupianf tueif sifyanf nir ti sirshianf tshungxfenx nes tsungfyaufshinf lungv lungv

spans.text: Yinsweir tueif chianrlif thungs tsifyour nir ti sa phupianf tueif sifyanf nir ti sirshianf tshungxfenx nes tsungfyaufshinf lungv lungv,

Thus Vleis ti Tauxtsenv Chix ti Chianrlif Shianxyanr nir, thas chix soyou thungs kuercas soyou thus tshens sirshianf ti piauxtsun kungfthungs, teyr chix thungs chixkouf sefhueif tshangrsir cif shianxyanr nir, thus tshens laiv sey thungs caufyur tshufcinf tueif chianrlif thungs tsifyour ti tsunxtsungf, laiv kuercas ti thungs kuercif ti tshorsix cianfcinf, si chianrlif thungs tsifyour nir kuer hueifyanr tsifcas ti chix thungs ngkair tsoxnur kuanshar ti thox ti chix ti luskleyx pof saix thungs tsunxshinr phupianf thungs nes shauf.

entries.task_id: ngkair shianxyanr|nir|zas ti chianrlif thungs tisfyour
entries.description: ngkair shianxyanr nir zas ti chianrlif thungs tisfyour
entries.subject: ngkair shianxyanr

spans.text: Chix nu nes tsixker nes ngkair shianxyanr nir zas ti chianrlif thungs tisfyour, tsix saix tsungtsur, yanrser qov, shinfpier, tsheis, tsungxcauf, tsenftsif huertse pleis tsoxnur ti cianfkai, kuercir, tshursenx sefhueif, tshairtshan, tsox huertse pleis tsoxnur ti senxfenf ti chixpier a.
Chix nu nes chianrlif ngkair farlir phinrten pauhuf, ngkair weirfan shianxyanr nir ti chirsif thungs sanxtungf chirsif nir ti shinrweir weirhaif a.

entries.description: saix lar nir tshus lar turlir
entries.subject: saix lar

spans.text: Tsix yinsweir chix ti kuercas huertse lar ti tsenftsif ti, shinrtsenf ti huertse kuercif ti tifweif nes purtungr soyi nes chixpier a, tsix saix lar nir tshus lar turlir, lar thorkuan, lar tsiftsif a huertse an tsenv pleis tsoxnur ti tsuchianr nes shianftsif ti qhau a.

entries.subject: huertse farlir
entries.object: ti chianrlif cixpen ngkair chinxhaif thuf

spans.text: Tsix saix tshus xennov, ngkair shianffar huertse farlir nir ti chianrlif cixpen ngkair chinxhaif thuf, nes chianrlif ngkair farthinr kuercas horker tueif chinxhaif nir thas nes shauf ti puciuf.

entries.task_id: tueif chinxhaif|nir|thas nes shauf ti puciuf
entries.description: tueif chinxhaif nir thas nes shauf ti puciuf
entries.subject: tueif chinxhaif

spans.text: Tsix saix tshus xennov, ngkair shianffar huertse farlir nir ti chianrlif cixpen ngkair chinxhaif thuf, nes chianrlif ngkair farthinr kuercas horker tueif chinxhaif nir thas nes shauf ti puciuf.
Chix nes chianrlif thus kuer, tsix saix kuercas nov a, klei nir nes kuercas tsifcas, nes chianrlif penx kuercas u.
Zurko ngkaur yeys tsueifshinr nes a tsenftsifshinf huertse weirpeif Kuer Lianrhor ti tsungxtsi thungs yanrtse ti shinrweir ngkair chisuf key, tsix laiv chianrlif nir a.

spans.text: Chianrlif nir nes kaipianf tsungxcauf huertse tsenv u ti tsifyour, thungs tanxtur huertse cirthi, kungxkhaix huertse mirmir laiv caufyif, sircanf, lipaif thungs kaiflir piausif tsungxcauf huertse tsenv u ti tsifyour.
Chianrlif nir nes tsifyour nes tsutsangx ngkair kanxser a, meirkaif nov nu laiv thung saix a kuerkaif laiv, pof thungs nir qhau thungs teyr ti tsifyour.
